request.style: English, Americana folk, male and female duet harmonies, acoustic guitar, banjo, mandolin, upright bass, light percussion, warm and hopeful, 98 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He saw the crowds and climbed the mountain, sat down on the ground
His followers came close to him, the people gathered round
He looked upon the weary ones, the poor and the oppressed
And he began to teach them, saying who is truly blessed

[Chorus]
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven
Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted
Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth

[Verse]
The widow at the graveside and the farmer in the drought
The ones who long for justice while the powerful shut them out
The ones who pardon freely and the hearts that hold no lie
The ones who build a bridge of peace where angry words go by

[Chorus]
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled
Blessed are the merciful, for they will receive mercy
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God

[Bridge]
Blessed are you when people insult you and persecute you
Rejoice and be glad, for your reward is great in heaven

[Chorus]
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven
Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted
Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth

[Outro]
Theirs is the kingdom of heaven
